creative_direction: Study a handful of dry reeds clustered near the bottom edge of a frozen lake. Their warm brown lines contrast with smooth blue-white ice, where faint trapped bubbles appear only close to the foreground. Use overcast winter light and very soft tonal transitions. Let the distant ice merge into pale mist, creating a spare and delicate sense of solitude. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
